evidence_slice: Chichester District Council adopted the Chichester Local Plan 2021-2039 on 19 August 2025. The adopted plan identifies Policy A2, Chichester City – Strategic Housing Location. Appendix E Housing Trajectory lists the Chichester City / Policy A2 strategic allocation with 270 dwellings in policy, 0 projected in 2025-30, 248 projected in 2030-39 and 248 projected across 2025-39; annual delivery starts with 12 dwellings in 2030/31.
